<｜ref｜>text<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[530,298,923,369]]<｜/box｜> East Lock 4 will remain on the manual schedule until the next scheduled calibration. The duty engineer will review the readings before the evening transfer. 
<｜ref｜>text<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[530,402,863,447]]<｜/box｜> Next review: 18:00 UTC / Ref. WR-206

A two-part field report

Issue 06 / Monitoring / 18 November 2026

LEFT COLUMN

The upper canal remained steady through the morning inspection. At North Gate 7, the sensor recorded 14.25 cm at 09:10 UTC.

A second reading, taken twelve minutes later, was 14.22 cm. The difference stayed inside the expected operating range.

Field staff cleaned the optical window and checked the cable housing for moisture.

RIGHT COLUMN

At Canal Bend 2, the team replaced the inlet filter and restarted the data logger. The first complete sample arrived at 10:42.

East Lock 4 will remain on the manual schedule until the next scheduled calibration. The duty engineer will review the readings before the evening transfer.

Next review: 18:00 UTC / Ref. WR-206
